sources.title: Listening, Reading, or Both? Rethinking the Comprehension Benefits of Reading-While-Listening
sources.sample: Mandarin-native English learners; final dataset 86; comprehension models N=70
sources.outcomes: Immediate comprehension and segmentation; no delayed efficacy endpoint

evidence.passage: The main effect for condition (LO = 1; RWL = −1) was significant
evidence.result: Comprehension favored RWL over LO, p=.002
evidence.limitations: Novel excerpts; not a Korean translation app; effective model sample differs from final dataset.

evidence.passage: a lack of main effect of condition
evidence.result: Preregistered segmentation model p=.16; sensitivity results conflict.
evidence.limitations: A nonsignificant result does not prove absence; no robust benefit established.

sources.title: Incidental Vocabulary Acquisition Through Captioned Viewing: A Meta-Analysis
sources.authors: Satsuki Kurokawa, Aung Myo Hein and Takumi Uchihara
sources.outcomes: Incidental vocabulary after L2-captioned vs uncaptioned video

evidence.passage: our meta-analysis could not shed light on the long-term retention of learning gains
evidence.result: Vocabulary g=.56, 95% CI [.38,.73]; only eight eligible studies used delayed posttests.
evidence.limitations: Video vocabulary evidence does not directly test audio-only app learning, Korean translation or durable listening.

sources.title: Foreign Subtitles Help but Native-Language Subtitles Harm Foreign Speech Perception
sources.authors: Holger Mitterer and James M. McQueen
sources.design: Six exposure groups; accent and subtitle-language manipulation
sources.sample: 120 Dutch university participants proficient in English
sources.outcomes: Immediate repetition of old/new audio fragments from unfamiliar English accents

evidence.passage: The effects of the subtitles were different for old and new items
evidence.result: Dutch subtitles favored old-fragment repetition but disadvantaged new fragments relative to no subtitles.
evidence.limitations: Does not establish general harm from Korean translation or long-term listening outcomes.
